sub_questions: What total environment-step budgets are reported in 2023-2026 legged-locomotion RL papers, with priority on hexapod and quadruped work using PPO and/or AMP?
What is the num_envs × iterations × rollout_length breakdown when reported?
What wall-clock training hours are reported?
What hardware (GPU model + count) is used in each paper?
Which papers report convergence at notably less or notably more than the median budget?
How are budgets distinguished across stages — BC pretrain, main RL run, fine-tune/DR — when reported separately?
For a single RTX 5060 Ti at ~240k it/s effective throughput, what total-step budget is reasonable to target?
Is the user's planned 100M-500M steps per session in a multi-session curriculum under-trained, on-trend, or over-trained vs published practice?
